service.description: Checks all tenants with expired trials and suspends them. Runs daily via cron.
Checks active subscriptions due for renewal and creates invoices. Runs daily via cron.
Sends email reminders for subscriptions expiring in 3 days and 1 day. Runs daily.
Suspends tenants with overdue invoices past the grace period. Runs daily.
Reactivates a suspended tenant after successful payment.
